title: pellionia longicaudata
intro: Pellionia longicaudata, commonly known as Long-Tailed Pellionia or Long-Tailed Upright Pellionia, is a type of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress, improve sleep quality, and protect against oxidative damage. The therapeutic actions of Pellionia longicaudata are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities, and display potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified in the plant's leaves and stems.
